description: This source will include all the Sideloading IPA updates for current and upcoming tweaks.

apps.name: Regram (No Plugins)
apps.subtitle: The all-in-one tweak for Instagram
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has original Instagram bundle ID. You need to delete original Instagram before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with free Apple IDs.

Regram is your all-in-one tweak for Instagram.

Currently available only to Patreon subscribers. Activate license by connecting your Patreon account from inside Regram Settings.

Access Regram settings by long-pressing on Home tab bar button or from Instagram settings.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Instagram uses your device's camera to do things like help you take photos, record videos and use effects.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Enable Face ID for quick and secure authentication on Instagram.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Instagram will use your contacts to suggest people and things you care about, and offer a better service. Your contacts will be periodically synced and securely stored on Instagram’s servers.
privacy.NSLocationUsageDescription: Instagram uses this to make some features work, personalize content and help people find places. You can change your preferences at any time in your device settings.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: This will let Instagram sync events to your calendar.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Instagram uses your device's microphone to do things like help you record videos and preview audio effects.
privacy.NSFocusStatusUsageDescription: This allows Instagram to check to see if you’ve been missing notifications from friends. You can always change this later in settings.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Instagram uses access to your camera roll to do things like help you share photos and videos to Instagram, apply effects and suggest photos and videos to share.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This allows Instagram to provide you with a better ads experience.
privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This allows your phone to find and connect to the glasses using a Bluetooth connection.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: This lets you save photos and videos to your Camera Roll.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Instagram uses this to make some features work, personalize content and help people find places. You can change your preferences at any time in your device settings.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Instagram uses this to make some features work, personalize content and help people find places. You can change your preferences at any time in your device settings.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Sideload: new-feature popups should no longer reset after relaunch, and notifications still show message content — the Fix Emojis & Popups switch is gone, both now work together.
- Reels: fixed Picture in Picture When Leaving doing nothing on some accounts.
- Chats: fixed Mark Seen not working after updating until turned off and on.
- Chats: marking a chat as seen from the + menu now gives haptic feedback.
- IG Feature Flags: new Try These pick "Instants" turns on Instants for accounts that don't have it yet.
- Stories: fixed Mark Seen skipping stories or marking the wrong one after a half swipe, and mentions showing another story's people.
- Profile Tracking & user lists: fixed "Response error" when adding someone by username.
- New Add Account screen (Profile Tracking, user lists, Media Vault): enter a username or profile link and preview the profile before adding it.
- Profile Analyzer: fixed scans missing a few of your followers and showing them as unfollowed.
- Profile Analyzer: delete the latest scan if it came back wrong (swipe it in History, or the trash button on the scan).
- Swipe Up for Disappearing Messages set to Block: fully disabled again.
- Profile Follow Status: no longer shows "Doesn't Follow You" by mistake on profiles opened from a following/followers list.
- Tab Bar: fixed a crash when a tab's hold action opens Saved (e.g. hold Profile → Saved).
- Explore hold (Open Link from Clipboard): also opens copied Regram links, like regram://settings?key=… setting links.
- Fixed a crash (iOS 26+) when a Regram "…" menu action removed its own row or screen, e.g. deleting an item.
- Backups: Export to Files no longer fails with "could not be read back" when an item is over 4 GB (e.g. a large Media Vault).
- Profile Follow Status (iPad): no longer squeezes the name and post/follower counts next to the profile picture.
- Activity Status button (DM inbox): no longer covers a long username or the verified badge.
- Pure Black in Dark Mode: fixed IG freezing at launch (then Safe Mode) on some jailbroken devices.
- iPhone Duo: chat Mark Seen button no longer stretches into a tall empty bar with Hide Regram in My Screenshots on.

Based on Instagram 454.1.0.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 451 and 452.
- Reels Limit: fixed crash when opening a reel from feed on IG 452.
- Messages Only: own settings page, switches in place (no restart), automatic schedule (times + days, switch instantly or ask first), optional Profile tab, Shortcuts links.
- Remove Tracking from Links: now also strips IG's new random tracking params (e.g. ?rpxt=, ?dlrf=).
- Follow Requests: warns before you send a follow request to someone who rejected one before (on by default).
- Follow Requests: new Received tab — tracks who asks to follow you and whether you approved, declined or they withdrew. Confirm/Delete right from the list, repeat requesters marked, new requests badged. Turn on Track Received Requests in settings.
- Follow Requests: redesigned list with filter chips (with counts) and clearer empty states.
- Reels Buttons: hide the new Shop Similar button.
- Feed: option to hide the full screen button that pops up over reels.
- Explore: option to hide the Suggested for you accounts in search. Hide Search History now also hides the empty Recent header.
- Media Watch: fixed new posts not being saved; posts that failed to save are retried; refresh says when it's paused.
- Media Watch: Select All in the Media screen, and Delete All Saved Media for every account at once (accounts list or settings).
- Profile Tracking: Watchlist can sort by Recently visited again (default while visits are recorded), so opened profiles move to the top.
- Restart alert: clearer buttons (Restart Now / Later) and says your change is already saved.
- Fixed ads (and Hide Reels) in the Explore grid.
- Fixed Profile Tracking badges on profiles not opening when tapped.
- Fixed IG freezing on Reels when the Share button is hidden.
- Fixed custom tabs not opening after adding or logging out of an account.
- Fixed profiles from Stories Archive viewers and other lists closing all screens first instead of opening on top.

Based on Instagram 452.0.1.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 450.1.
- New Story Playback Controls: speed, scrubbing, skip, volume, mute, Picture in Picture, save frame and next person for stories. Open with a long-press on •••, the new playback button or the action button. Stop Auto Advance moved there too.
- Reels Playback Controls: new previous/next reel and skip buttons (5s by default). When paused, skip steps one frame; hold to repeat. Also available as floating button actions.
- New Media Watch (Profile Tracking): watched accounts can have their new stories, posts, reels and profile pictures saved automatically, shown in the events list and viewable there.
- New per-account Media screen: all saved media by type, a Deleted filter, full-screen viewer, and export to Photos or the Vault.
- Profile Tracking now centers on the Watchlist: it opens on Watchlist | Changes, and recording profile visits is optional (off by default).
- Profile Tracking: now tracks links and their titles, pronouns, category, account type and contact info.
- Profile Tracking: fixed false profile picture changes, mostly on accounts without a picture.
- New Save All Media on the profile action button: posts, carousels, reels, stories and the profile picture in bulk.
- Instants: new Manually Mark as Seen. Viewed instants stay unseen until you tap the eye button.
- Reel Buttons: hide IG's new Save button on Reels, or just its count.
- Redesigned Tab Bar editor: live preview, add or hide tabs with + and −, and changes apply without relaunching.
- Tab Bar: add custom tabs, like IG's Saved and Notifications or Regram screens such as the Vault, Downloads and Settings.
- Tab Bar: hold any tab to open a screen of your choice (Home still opens Regram Settings).
- Detect IG Links moved to the Tab Bar editor as Explore's hold action (your setting carries over).
- Stacked Toast notifications now share one width instead of zig-zagging.
- Downloads: filter chips above the list, plus a Select button to delete many downloads at once, with or without their media.
- Fixed Hide Chats and the DM refresh confirmation not working on IG's new chats list.
- Fixed video Instants downloading as a photo.
- Fixed IG crashing at launch on some accounts.

Based on Instagram 450.1.0.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 448.
- New Reels Limit (replaces Reels Scrolling): daily reels or minutes limit per place, with usage stats, a 7-day chart and break reminders.
- New Tappable Links (General): web links in captions and comments can now be tapped to open. On by default.
- Deleted Messages Log: new Show in Chat — opens the chat and jumps to where the message was (tap text entries or long-press any entry).
- Hide Buttons is now Post Buttons and Reel Buttons: show, hide, or hide just the count of each button, plus the like and repost confirmations.
- Feed, Reels and Stories Filtering, and the new button pages, moved from Interface into the Feed, Reels and Stories sections.
- Moved Stories "Hide Suggested Users" into Stories Filtering.
- Profile Tracking: safer watchlist checks — they start a few seconds after launch, pause for a day if Instagram limits the account, and run at most every 2 hours.
- Fixed Full Last Active Date not showing in chats.
- Fixed "Music for you" and "Suggested for you" cards still showing in Stories.
- Notifications now use the Solid background by default, and Toast text lines up next to its icon.
- Fixed IG+ Story Preview showing the upsell instead of the story when long-pressing an avatar outside the stories bar (comments, DMs, search, activity, feed posts).

Based on Instagram 448.0.0.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 447.
- New in-app notification system. Several notifications can now show at once, stacked, instead of one at a time.
- Notifications come in two looks — Banner (full width, default) and Toast (small pill) — set globally or per feature under Settings > Notifications.
- New Notification History: every notification Regram showed, filterable by feature, and tapping one opens what the banner would have opened.
- New Stories Filtering page under Interface > Stories Tray, with a switch per card IG inserts between stories: Join Trending, Popular, Your Turn, Music, Restyle, Meta AI, Threads and other cards.
- New Reels Playback Controls: open them three ways — long-press the ••• button, a floating button you can drag anywhere on the reel, or the Regram action button — for a sheet with play/pause, a scrubber with elapsed and remaining time, a six-stop speed selector (0.5× to 2×), auto-advance, keep speed, mute, full screen, Picture in Picture, save the current frame, and a reels-only volume. Kept speed applies to every reel and survives relaunch.
- Profile > Spoofing is now one page with a live preview, a master switch, and a section per value: followers, following, posts, verified badge, and the new username and display name spoofs. With the master switch off nothing spoofing-related runs at all. The names show everywhere in the app but stay on your device — your real account is untouched, and Edit Profile always shows the real values.
- Reels auto-advance now also moves past sponsored reels instead of leaving them looping.
- New “Leave Chat After Seen” option under Messages > Send Seen On... — closes the chat and goes back to the inbox after you send seen from the bar button or the + menu.
- Open in Regram Safari extension now shows a banner on Instagram pages with an Open button, so links reach Regram on the first page instead of only after tapping the reel or Open in Instagram.
- New Ads section: one place for hiding ads, with a Hide All Ads master switch plus per-place switches for Feed, Stories, Explore and Reels. Your existing ad settings carry over, and the old spots under Feed / Reels Filtering and Interface now link to the new section.
- Added Crash Logs under App Utilities. Regram now writes a report whenever IG crashes, so you can read it, search it, and share it when reporting a problem.
- Device ID: added a required warning screen explaining who the feature is for before masking can be turned on, plus a How It Works page answering the common questions.
- Fixed “Fix Pop-ups & Emoji” not staying off. The setting was stored in the App Group container, which is missing on apps signed without App Group support, so the switch turned itself back on.
- Fixed the story mark-seen button menu showing the previous account's name and the wrong exclude/include action after moving to the next story.
- What's New now has a Previous Versions button — browse the highlights of every Regram release since 5.0.

Based on Instagram 447.0.0.

apps.name: Watusi
apps.subtitle: The all-in-one tweak for WhatsApp
apps.localizedDescription:
Watusi is your all-in-one tweak for WhatsApp Messenger.

This is an original version, it has original WhatsApp bundle ID, you need to delete original WhatsApp before installing.

privacy.NSSiriUsageDescription: This lets you use Siri to quickly send and read messages and make calls.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This lets you make video calls, take photos, and record videos.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to authenticate on WhatsApp.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Upload your contacts to WhatsApp's servers to help you quickly get in touch with your friends and help us provide a better experience.
privacy.NSLocationUsageDescription: This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: This lets you create events on your calendar.
privacy.NSRemindersUsageDescription: This lets you set reminders to call your friends back.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you make calls, send voice messages, and record videos with sound.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This will let you use WhatsApp to place and receive calls through devices that are on the same Wi-Fi or local access networks.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This lets you send photos and videos from your library and save the ones you capture.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: If you always allow access to your location, you can choose to share your live location, and it will update even when you're not using the app. This also lets you send your current location or a nearby place.
privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This lets you connect to supported Bluetooth devices
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: This lets you save photos and videos to your library.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: WhatsApp does on-device recognition for Voice Messages. In this mode, no voice data is sent to Apple despite this alert, which is unexpected. Select "Don't Allow" and report to WhatsApp.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: This lets you connect to supported Bluetooth devices
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you always allow access to your location, you can choose to share your live location, and it will update even when you're not using the app. If you only allow access while using the app, you can only send your current location or a nearby place.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes & support for WhatsApp 26.42
- Fixed photos, videos, documents, camera captures, contacts & locations not sending from the Share Sheet.
- Fixed Watusi not loading on RootHide after converting with RootHide Patcher.

Based on WhatsApp 26.42.77.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes & support for WhatsApp 26.41
- Fixed viewed statuses being marked as seen for their sender after relaunching WhatsApp with Mark as Viewed enabled.
- Fixed a crash when viewing some statuses with the Download or Mark as Viewed buttons enabled.
- Fixed Allow View Once Screenshot/Recording not working on newer WhatsApp versions.

Based on WhatsApp 26.41.75.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes & support for WhatsApp 26.41.X
- Fixed Status Archive not saving your statuses or their viewers on WhatsApp's new internal status storage.
- Fixed a crash when viewing a status from the Statuses Bar.

Based on WhatsApp 26.41.74.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes & support for WhatsApp 26.38.X
- Fixed voice notes not playing or recording on sideloaded installs missing WhatsApp's extended-virtual-addressing entitlement.

Based on WhatsApp 26.38.74.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes & support for WhatsApp 26.37.X
- Fixed Unlimited Pinned Chats blocking pinned chats from being unpinned.
- Fixed Keep Edited Messages History showing the edited text in place of the original message.
- Keep Edited Messages History now also records edits made in disappearing chats, edits made from a linked device, and edited media captions.
- Fixed the statuses bar on the chats list not appearing at all for some accounts on WhatsApp's new internal status storage.

Based on WhatsApp 26.37.76.
